subject: Follow-up: ownership, procurement path, and security evidence needed
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@stemmahealth.com>, Miguel Soto <miguel.soto@stemmahealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.inference, neha_kapoor@redwood.inference
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up from today's demo — org ownership + procurement steps

Hi Jamie / Miguel —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can map the next steps internally and with your procurement/legal teams: 

1) Primary economic buyer: you mentioned finance would sign off for platform spend. Can you confirm the person and title who will own the budget? (We typically need the econ buyer name and an approver email to route commercial docs.)

2) Security evidence: Marcus flagged that your security lead may want SOC2 artifacts, data-retention details, and network isolation options. Could you share the names/emails for whoever handles security/compliance so we can send a concise evidence bundle (one-pager + attachments)?

3) Procurement/legal steps: please outline your procurement path (PO vs. contract vs. e-sign), any required terms that usually get redlined, and the expected timeline for signature. A one-line description is perfect.

4) Org chart: if you have a simple org chart or a short roster of approvers (economic buyer, security lead, procurement contact), that will help us build a mutual action plan. If easier, attach whatever you have.

Next steps from our side: once we have the three names above we will:
- Send a tailored SOC2/evidence packet and one-page commercial summary.
- Draft a tentative mutual action plan with milestones for pilot -> procurement -> production.
- Schedule a 30-min handoff with your security and procurement teams (we have availability Tue/Wed next week).

Attachments referenced: example evidence bundle (SOC2 one-pager), mutual action plan template.

If easier, drop the org chart and procurement contact in reply and I will consolidate. Thanks — appreciate the quick help here.

Best,
Olga
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.inference
Attachment: redwood-evidence-onepager.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@stemmahealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
Cc: Miguel Soto <miguel.soto@stemmahealth.com>, procurement@stemmahealth.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — org ownership + procurement steps

Thanks Olga — good session today. See answers inline below and attaching a light org chart.

> 1) Primary economic buyer
Our VP of Finance, Dana Kline (dana.kline@stemmahealth.com), will own the budget sign-off. If helpful, kop in our CFO (cfo@stemmahealth.com) for large-ticket items.

> 2) Security evidence
Security lead is Miguel Soto (miguel.soto@stemmahealth.com) — I've looped him. He'll want SOC2 Type II summary, data residency notes, and audit log retention policy.

> 3) Procurement/legal steps
Procurement does a short form review + PO for pilots <$50k. For enterprise contracts we go through Legal — expect a 2–3 week review cycle. Procurement contact is procurement@stemmahealth.com (cc'd).

Attaching: stemma_org_chart_v2.pdf (shows Dana / Miguel / Procurement).

I can do a 30-min sync with Miguel + procurement next Wed (Dec 9) at 10am PT. Does that work on your side?

-Jamie
Principal Product Manager, Stemma Health
Attachment: stemma_org_chart_v2.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>, Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@stemmahealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.inference
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 18:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — org ownership + procurement steps

Thanks Jamie — great clarity. Couple internal asks from our side (looping Neha from Legal as FYI):

- Jamie / Miguel: when Miguel reviews the SOC2 summary, could you indicate any gaps vs. your SOW? If there are specific controls you require (e.g., encryption-at-rest certification, dedicated log retention windows), call them out and we'll produce targeted artifacts.
- Procurement: if you use a standard PO, could you share a copy or the typical PO fields so our finance team can prefill and speed signature?

Olga: I'll assemble a compact evidence packet (SOC2 excerpt, audit-log sample, data retention table) and a first-pass mutual action plan. Putting the draft in Google Docs so Jamie can edit.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.inference

Attachment: purchase_timeline_table.xlsx (internal draft)

From: Miguel Soto <miguel.soto@stemmahealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@stemmahealth.com>, procurement@stemmahealth.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — org ownership + procurement steps

Olga / Marcus — thanks. Wed Dec 9 at 10am PT works for me.

I've attached a short procurement checklist and a redacted example PO we typically use for pilots (see purchase_timeline_table.xlsx). On SOC2: we use the summary to validate controls but will request the SOC2 Type II report during contract negotiation. For now, the SOC2 one-pager plus a short paragraph on how you handle KV caching and log retention will be sufficient to proceed to procurement.

We'll share the economic buyer intro (Dana) in a separate email to keep threads small.

Regards,
Miguel Soto
Head of Security Engineering, Stemma Health
Attachment: SOC2_summary_request.docx (attachment stub)
